title: Ambient component normalization for compact-support Frobenius
statement: In the finite-field setting of lem-pur-frobenius-compact-integral-normalization, the underlying ambient morphism of the compact integral Frobenius exchange agrees heterogeneously with the underlying ambient morphism of RationalWeilPurity.integralExchange at every integral constructible object.

source.place: Step 2, proper/open compact-support transport before restriction to the constructible wrapper

proof.text: Expand the compact exchange into its normalized proper mate, system compact exchange, and inverse open mate. Compare each mate with the coefficient-normalized completed Frobenius square and paste the unit, square, and counit equations; the quotient transitions are preserved componentwise.

Cancel the intervening projection-normalized compact-support realization and its inverse. The remaining completed-to-ordinary factors and the completed compact-support Frobenius comparison are exactly the factors defining RationalWeilPurity.integralExchange; projecting to the underlying ambient hom gives the stated heterogeneous equality.

mathlib_searches.query: frobeniusCompactIntegral normalization and integralExchange component comparison
mathlib_searches.results: No existing comparison theorem; the only definitions are FrobeniusExchange.frobeniusCompactIntegral and RationalWeilPurity.integralExchange.

lean.statement:
theorem frobeniusCompactIntegral_ambient_normalization
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X₀ Y₀ : Over (Spec (.of D.k₀))}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X₀.hom] [QuasiCompact X₀.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Y₀.hom] [QuasiCompact Y₀.hom]
    (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀) [IsSeparated f₀.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f₀.left] [QuasiCompact f₀.left]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (c₀ : Compactification f₀.left)
    (M : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E (D.geometricFiber X₀).left) :
    HEq ((FrobeniusExchange.frobeniusCompactIntegral D l hl E f₀ c₀).app M).hom
      (RationalWeilPurity.integralExchange D l hl f₀ E c₀ M).hom.hom
